name: Ooeyama Inori
source:
Inori is Leo's homeroom teacher to his class of 2-C, and an adviser of student council. She seems to be absent minded, and is often late for school despite being the teacher.

[spoiler] Has special ability to tell when some one is a virgin and only has sex with virgins. Is secretly depressed all the time.   [/spoiler]

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tsuyokiss]Wikipedia[/url]]
